brief_summary: Annotated cross-section of a Kailh Box White switch, showing the box-stem housing enclosing the stem, the click bar positioned at the tactile bump where it snaps against the stem, a sound-wave glyph marking the click firing at the 45g actuation point, and a separate bottom-out line at 60g to show the click fires well before bottom-out.
